summary.goal: Build the frontend application for human-initiated brainstorming sessions. Provides a conversational interface with the Interviewer agent while displaying specialist observations in real-time.
in_scope: Chat interface with Interviewer (pure user ↔ Interviewer, no specialist interjections)
Specialist observations panel (minimal view - confidence, keywords, alerts)
Confidence bar and Send to Planner action in chat header
Relay WebSocket/SSE integration for real-time updates
constraints: Must use existing design system (Mission Control theme)
Must follow planner-ui patterns (React, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui)
WebSocket connection to ideation-core for real-time messaging
Reuse components from planner-ui where applicable

acceptance_criteria.description: User can create a new ideation session from the UI
User can see list of sessions with status indicators (active, abandoned)
Chat interface displays conversation with Interviewer (user ↔ assistant only)
Right sidebar shows specialist confidence and keywords in real-time
Concerns and questions from specialists are highlighted in sidebar
Confidence bar in header shows aggregate confidence (red→orange→green)
Send to Planner button always enabled (advisory confidence, not blocking)
Sessions stay active after sending to Planner (continue ideating)

decisions.rationale: Clean separation, independent deployment, mirrors planner-ui pattern
Show confidence, keywords, alerts only - full details in v2
Consistent with planner-ui, familiar pattern for users
Specialists contribute via sidebar, not chat. Interviewer facilitates conversation.
Simpler MVP, extract to shared-ui later when both UIs are stable
